subject: Sequenced demo handshake: Azure SI + CloudIntegrator (three-way sequencing and rehearsal)
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: CloudIntegrator Sales <sales@cloudintegrator.io>, Rajesh Patel <rajesh.p@cloudintegrator.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sequenced demo handshake: Azure SI + CloudIntegrator (three-way sequencing and rehearsal)

Hi Rajesh / CloudIntegrator team,

Thanks for agreeing to the joint customer demo for AcmeRetail next week. To make this three-way session smooth (Azure marketplace PM + your SI + Redwood), I'd like to propose an explicit sequence and a short dry-run:

1) 15m Exec intro (A/V, objectives) — Azure PM + CloudIntegrator execs + Redwood GTM
2) 25m Technical deep-dive — CloudIntegrator SI lead + Redwood infra engineer (live demo of inference routing)
3) 10m Integration Q&A + next steps — all parties

Options for the unified session that fit AcmeRetail's preference (they asked for APAC-friendly times):
- Option A: Tue 2027-08-31 08:00 PDT / 23:00 IST (tight for APAC execs, not ideal)
- Option B: Wed 2027-09-01 02:00 PDT / 13:30 IST (preferred by Acme Retail EMEA/APAC mix)
- Option C: Split into two short blocks on the same day: Exec block at 22:00 IST and Tech block at 03:00 IST (we'd handle handover in the same calendar day)

I've attached a baseline runbook and a draft agenda. Please confirm availability and whether your SI lead (technical host) can join the dry-run 24–48 hours prior.

Attachments: [attachment: redwood_runbook_v0.3.pdf (PDF)], [attachment: three-way_agenda_v2.xlsx (Excel)]

Thanks — happy to iterate on times.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

---
From: Rajesh Patel <rajesh.p@cloudintegrator.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, CloudIntegrator Sales <sales@cloudintegrator.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 18:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sequenced demo handshake: Azure SI + CloudIntegrator (three-way sequencing and rehearsal)

Thanks Irene — this looks good at a high level. Quick notes: 

- We can cover the technical deep-dive but will need our SI lead (Anita Rao) to take the live walkthrough on our side. Anita is available most mornings IST but is blocked late evenings PST.
- AcmeRetail's procurement team prefers a single session if possible to avoid re-scheduling stakeholders, but they prioritized APAC overlap.
- Can we do a 30-minute dry-run on Tue 2027-08-30 UTC 02:00 (that maps to Tue 2027-08-30 11:30 IST for Anita)?

Quoted for context:
> I've attached a baseline runbook and a draft agenda. Please confirm availability and whether your SI lead (technical host) can join the dry-run 24–48 hours prior.

If we split exec and technical, we risk losing continuity with procurement folks — they'd prefer Option B if we can make Anita join. I'll ask AcmeRetail to confirm they can join Option B; need Redwood to lock a concrete time for the dry-run.

Rajesh
Rajesh Patel
Head of Alliances, CloudIntegrator
rajesh.p@cloudintegrator.io
+91 80 5555 1212
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Rajesh Patel <rajesh.p@cloudintegrator.io>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sequenced demo handshake: Azure SI + CloudIntegrator (three-way sequencing and rehearsal)

Great — thanks Rajesh. Quick operational proposal from our side to reduce risk: 

1) Lock Option B as the primary session: Wed 2027-09-01 02:00 PDT / 13:30 IST — this keeps exec + SI together for continuity.
2) Schedule the dry-run: Tue 2027-08-30 18:00 PDT / Wed 2027-08-31 07:30 IST. (We can be flexible if Anita really needs morning IST; the timestamp above maps to late evening PDT but still within working hours for our infra lead.)
3) Contingency: If Anita cannot make the live session, CloudIntegrator SI can record a short 8–10 minute demo snippet that we can play during the technical deep-dive, and we'll allocate 10 minutes for a live Q&A.

I've updated the agenda with a timing cushion and a host handoff script that clarifies who mutes/unmutes and how we route the live inference traffic to the demo cluster. See attachments in my reply.

Quoted: 
> If we split exec and technical, we risk losing continuity with procurement folks — they'd prefer Option B if we can make Anita join.

@Vanessa: can you lock the Zoom and send out a calendar invite with both options shaded, then we'll finalize once AcmeRetail confirms?

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Rajesh Patel <rajesh.p@cloudintegrator.io>, CloudIntegrator Sales <sales@cloudintegrator.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Azure Marketplace PM <pm@azuremarketplace.microsoft.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sequenced demo handshake: Azure SI + CloudIntegrator (three-way sequencing and rehearsal)

Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. Final items before I push invites: 

- We will tentatively lock Option B: Wed 2027-09-01 02:00 PDT / 13:30 IST for the single, sequenced session.
- Dry-run confirmed for Tue 2027-08-30 18:00 PDT / Wed 2027-08-31 07:30 IST. Please flag any absolute cannot-attend windows now.
- Vanessa: please create the invite and attach the runbook (redwood_runbook_v0.3.pdf) and the updated agenda (three-way_agenda_v2.xlsx).
- Rajesh: if Anita prefers a morning IST dry-run, propose two 30-minute windows and we will re-check with our infra lead.

I've added the HubSpot deal link and Drive folder to the invite; I also included the rehearsal Zoom link in case we need a backup room on demo day.

Next steps: Vanessa to create invites; Rajesh to confirm Anita; AcmeRetail to confirm attendee list.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
